info.name: Medicare API
info.description:
All endpoints are served under the `/api` prefix and speak JSON.

Requests must send `Accept: application/json`; without it Laravel falls back
to HTML error pages instead of the JSON error bodies documented here.

request.description:
Moves the appointment from `pending` to `confirmed`, which is the doctor
accepting the booking.

Only a `pending` appointment can be confirmed; every other status answers
with a 422 and the appointment is left untouched. The endpoint takes no body.

response.name:

The transition is not allowed, or the body failed validation.

A rejected transition is reported on a `status` key even though the client never
submits a status: the target is decided by the endpoint, not by the body.

request.description:
Moves the appointment from `confirmed` to `completed`, which is the doctor
closing the visit. `completed` is a final status.

Only a `confirmed` appointment can be completed — a `pending` one has to be
confirmed first. The endpoint takes no body.

response.name:

A rejected transition is reported on a `status` key even though the client never
submits a status: the target is decided by the endpoint, not by the body.

request.description:
Moves a `pending` or `confirmed` appointment to `canceled`, which is a final
status, and stores the reason.

A `pending` appointment can be cancelled at any time. A `confirmed` one only
until 24 hours before it starts; later than that the request is rejected and
the appointment stays confirmed.

Cancelling releases the slot: it shows up in the doctor's free slots again,
and another patient can book it.

request.description:
Books one slot of a doctor's availability for the patient. The created
appointment always starts in the `pending` status.

The requested period has to be exactly one bookable slot: it must fall
inside an availability of the doctor, start on the slot grid anchored by
that availability's `starts_at`, and be as long as its `slot`. The slot must
also be free, meaning no other appointment of the same doctor covers it in a
status other than `canceled`.
